objects.parameters: Any real tau>0, integer dimension d>=2; T>max(e,tau+1)
objects.domain: Disk 0<r<exp(-T), times a bounded open box in the extra coordinates
failed_claims: e^(tau K) integrable and finite energy imply |F|^2 log^(tau-1)(e+|F|) locally integrable
e^(tau K) integrable and finite energy imply J log^tau(e+J) locally integrable
objects.divergence_witness: Both critical target integrals have a tail comparable to integral_T^infinity dt/(t*log t)

particularly_concrete_member.failure: Neither gradient nor flux is locally in L^2

objects.scope: Sharpness at the critical logarithmic exponent for scalar symmetric degenerate elliptic equations in every dimension. No algorithmic impossibility result.
objects.provenance: Radial logarithmic extremal method has planar precedent in Astala-Gill-Rohde-Saksman 2010. Explicit formulas and higher-dimensional embedding are verified in this report.

definitions.fields_and_coefficient: Same polar E,B,A construction as critical_exponential_distortion_endpoint

objects.moment_property: For every finite sigma>0, integral exp(sigma*K) is finite, from integral exp(-2*t+sigma*sqrt(t)) dt
objects.failed_claim: All finite exponential moments of K imply some local L^(2+epsilon) gain for the gradient/flux
objects.divergence_witness: For every p>2, field L^p integral dominates integral exp((p-2)*t-2*p*sqrt(t)) dt, which diverges
objects.scope: No universal power improvement follows from all exponential distortion moments. All finite logarithmic improvements remain consistent with the theorem.
